profile.source_basis: EMA Yervoy product information updated 24 June 2026, sections4.2/4.4/4.8; NCCP00712v3a and00792v2 checked29October2026. Risks are medicine-wide; exact schedule and likelihood vary by regimen. Independent clinical/pharmacy review pending.
risks: Immune inflammation can affect bowel, lungs, liver, kidneys, skin, hormone glands, heart, muscles, nerves and other organs; some events can be severe or fatal.
Myocarditis, myositis and myasthenia can overlap. New chest pain, palpitations, marked weakness, drooping eyelids or swallowing/breathing difficulty require urgent assessment.
Immune effects may start during or after treatment; persistent hormone deficiency can need long-term replacement. Carry the immune alert card and report symptoms promptly.
Severe infusion reactions and severe blistering/peeling skin reactions including SJS/TEN can occur.
